blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver two closure-ready release-convergence repairs: make the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper route playable and authoritative, and restore one recognizable, bounded Effects-bus cue per automatic Warden Lantern attack while preserving retained authored assets and lifecycle behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authoritative wave/run integration still permits terminal evidence through diagnostic preparation without proving ordinary progression across all five waves, while the lantern attack event chain reaches combat state but its product-owned Effects voice binding/mix path remains silent despite repeated adapter treatments.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule deferred dense-renderer performance or arena-framing issue ids as current tasks.
Do not replace preserved map, weapon, or audio packages; stop after candidate repairs and bounded recapture predicates are available for Tester.
Do not use diagnostic preparation, synthetic ledger rows, or telemetry alone as proof of an ordinary successful route.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach from prior tuning: repair the wave director/run-controller state machine and ordinary-route receipts directly, and isolate the lantern audio at the scene-bound AudioStreamPlayer/resource binding boundary with explicit one-transaction ownership and bounded retirement.

code: Run the frozen native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks after edits.
Verify tester-only actions remain unavailable in release exports and no parser/runtime errors are introduced.
White-box inspect wave snapshots, transition history, ordinary_route_eligible, boss trigger count, terminal transition count, retry reset receipts, upgrade card values, and focus-device state.
runtime: Use a real ordinary movement/combat replay from spawn and collect runtime-state checkpoints at waves 1-5, Bellkeeper entry/phase changes, Result, and Retry; pair each checkpoint with a distinct shipped-camera screenshot.

Run the runtime audio causality probe on a fresh run: capture Effects and Master, allow one automatic lantern authorization plus its hit or miss, stop capture, and correlate attack id, semantic receipt, source path, bus, waveform onset, and bounded retirement; repeat after reset/retry to prove no stale voice or duplicate.
Retest the same failed route/audio cells after any bounded correction and stop once fresh candidate-bound evidence is ready for Tester closure.
visual: Capture spawn, mid-route, wave-4, wave-5/Bellkeeper, Result, and Retry frames showing readable route progression, external depth, central building/landmark visibility, collision-safe perimeter, and no disappearance or occlusion during ordinary movement.
Capture the level-up draft in keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states with silhouette/icon hierarchy and truthful current-to-new deltas.
Capture representative lantern attack onset and impact frames at different runtime times, paired with HUD and VFX state, to verify no duplicate shot presentation.

done_when: A fresh ordinary run advances through wave 1, wave 2, wave 3, wave 4, and wave 5 in order with authoritative wave ids, elapsed timers, spawn budgets, and live-cap state; diagnostic jumps cannot mark the route eligible.
Wave 5 requests the Bellkeeper exactly once, exposes its boss-health/two-phase encounter state, and no ordinary spawning continues after victory, failure, Result, or Retry.
Result and Retry can be reached from the completed ordinary route and a retry starts with reset wave, boss, timer, entity, pickup, pause, and terminal counters.

Traversal proves expand or larger traversable scale, a coherent external world or external depth, and a visible central building or landmark; every route and perimeter boundary has aligned collision with no disappearance or occlusion during ordinary movement or a movement replay.

The level-up choice surface leads with an authored silhouette/icon, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/confirm states without placeholder CURRENT values.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative wave director/run-controller transition path and its ordinary gameplay bindings. Trace warmup, active-wave completion, boss request, Bellkeeper phase entry, victory/failure/result handoff, teardown, and retry reset; remove route deadlocks or diagnostic-only completion paths while preserving native authored cemetery composition. Rebase spawn/objective/navigation and collision checks on the authored world so the route can expand to a larger traversable scale with external world/external depth, a stable central building/landmark, perimeter/boundary containment, and visibility under ordinary movement. Keep tester-only preparation isolated behind editor/release guards. In the same run-lifecycle surface, repair the existing upgrade draft presentation only as needed to satisfy the required authored choice hierarchy and input focus contract; do not turn it into a generic text stack.
tasks.title: Restore ordinary five-wave route, spatial integrity, and choice flow

done_when: One ordinary automatic Warden Lantern attack authorization produces exactly one audible, recognizable bounded transient on the Effects bus, with a source-event timestamp and semantic receipt tied to that attack id.

Attack impact or miss feedback is causally distinct from the player report; generic bolt/VFX presentation does not replay the complete player cue, and unreliable world-surface material cues remain disabled rather than substituting a long ringing or generic collision sound.

Rapid automatic cadence does not overwrite or duplicate the dedicated report before its bounded window is heard; lifecycle reset, pause ownership, death, Result, and Retry stop pending voices and clear dedupe state.

Audio source/resource binding is valid at runtime, the retained authored package remains unchanged, and Tester can correlate one attack event to one Effects waveform onset plus any separate hit feedback in a mixed-output capture.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned Mournlight audio adapter at the direct scene-bound voice/resource boundary rather than repeating transform or generic pool tuning. Verify the authored lantern onset/impact streams load, route to Effects, start only from authoritative AttackRuntime authorization/hit-or-miss events, and retire within bounded windows. Preserve retained audio assets and existing weapon behavior; keep enemy spatial reports separate, suppress unreliable world-surface impact audio while retaining compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback, and ensure reset/retry invalidates pending playback and dedupe keys.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern Effects-bus report causality
